senses.gloss:
[गुम्फ्-घञ्] 
__1 Tying, stringing together; गुम्फो वाणीनाम् [[B. R. 1. 1.]] 
__2 Putting together, composing, arrangement. 
__3 A bracelet. 
__4 A whisker, a mustachio.

[गुम्फ्-युच्] 
__1 Stringing together. 
__2 Arranging, composing. 
__3 Good adjustment (of words and their senses), good composition; वाक्ये शब्दार्थयोः सम्यग्रचना गुम्फना मता.
A woman with her face covered with a veil. [[L. D. B.]]
